subject.title: Control UI: Memory panel for MEMORY.md and USER.md

question: Should OpenClaw add a core Control UI memory editor for MEMORY.md, USER.md, and daily notes now, or should this wait for the broader workspace-file and Control UI contribution-slot designs?
rationale: The request is useful but it chooses a browser-accessible read/write surface for sensitive prompt and user-memory files, and current main only has a generic allowlisted file editor plus read-only workspace browsing.

options.title: Keep as a product/security review packet
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers decide the core-vs-plugin UI boundary and the daily-note write contract alongside the related workspace and contribution-slot issues.

options.title: Implement a narrow core panel
options.body: Build a memory-specific Control UI panel using the existing allowlisted file editor for root files and a separately reviewed scoped daily-note API.

options.title: Defer to plugin slots
options.body: Let this become a memory plugin or ClawHub package after safe Control UI contribution slots exist, rather than adding more core UI now.

recommendation.title: Keep as a product/security review packet
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers decide the core-vs-plugin UI boundary and the daily-note write contract alongside the related workspace and contribution-slot issues.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses the gateway workspace API and security/product boundary that @steipete recently shaped with the read-only workspace browsing RPCs.
